summary: First-finish smoke tests for Verdaleaf plant disease detection app. Verified 3 public endpoints, 2 protected 401s, anonymous /api/detect with real Gemini call, authenticated detect + history + delete via mock mongo session, and core frontend flows (landing render, sign-in redirect target, anonymous vs authed dashboard).
passed: GET /api/ returns 200 with {status: ok, message: 'Plant Disease Detection API'}
GET /api/diseases returns 200 with 6 items and correct keys (id,name,plant,type,severity,symptoms,treatment,image)
GET /api/tips returns 200 with 6 items and correct keys (id,title,body,image)

POST /api/detect anonymous with real leaf JPEG (~28KB) returns 200; Gemini identified 'Black Spot' on 'Rose' with all required fields; user_id is null; scan NOT persisted (history remains 401 without auth)
POST /api/detect authenticated (Bearer token from mongo session) returns 200 and persists; GET /api/history then returns 1 item with matching id
DELETE /api/history/{det_id} authenticated returns {deleted: 1}; subsequent history returns []
Landing page renders with data-testid='landing-page', hero+CTA visible ('Sign in & diagnose', 'Sign in with Google')

Clicking 'Sign in & diagnose' navigates to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<dashboard-url> (verified in source Header.jsx/Landing.jsx/Dashboard.jsx); browser follows redirect chain via demobackend.emergentagent.com to Google OAuth as expected
Anonymous /dashboard renders data-testid='dashboard-page' and upload-area; user-badge and history section NOT present (correct)
Authed /dashboard (mock cookie) shows data-testid='user-badge' with user name and history-empty section with 'No scans yet. Diagnose a leaf above and it appears here.'
action_items: Minor: review request referenced data-testid='history-section' but actual testids are 'history-empty' and 'history-card-{i}'. Behavior is correct; only the testid naming in review request differs. No code change required unless a wrapper testid is desired.

Upload+Diagnose end-to-end UI flow (drag/drop → run-detection-btn → DiagnosisResult render) was NOT executed in this smoke pass because the Gemini call was already validated via backend and the review notes 5-15s runtime. Defer to full testing agent.
